requestExpired: This request has expired. Start again from the extension icon.
notInHistory: This summary is no longer in history.

config.baseUrl: Set a Base URL for the custom provider in Settings.
config.apiKey: Add your {{provider}} API key in Settings.

llm.localRefused: The local server refused the request (HTTP 403). Open Settings and click Save to grant access to it, then try again.
llm.keyRejected: The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings.
llm.accessDenied: Access denied (HTTP 403): the key may not have access to this model.
llm.notFound: Model or endpoint not found. Check the model name and Base URL.
llm.rateLimited: Rate limited or out of quota. Try again later or switch model.
llm.network: Could not reach the provider (network, CORS, or missing permission for the API domain). Save Settings again.

models.unreachable: Could not reach the provider. Check the Base URL, your network, or that the local server is running.
models.forbidden: Access denied (HTTP 403). For local servers, click Save to grant access.

page.restricted: The browser does not allow extensions to read this page.
page.pdfDownload: Could not download the PDF. Save it and upload the file instead.
page.noAccess: No access to that page anymore. Open the extension on the page and try again.
page.readFailed: Could not read the page content.
page.noText: This page has no text to summarize.

file.unsupported: Unsupported file type “{{type}}”. Supported: PDF, CSV, MD, TXT, HTML, JSON.

video.notVideo: No YouTube video found in this tab.
video.live: This is a live stream. Summarize it after it ends.
video.noCaptions: This video has no captions, so there is nothing to summarize.
video.transcriptFailed: Could not read this video’s captions. Reload the YouTube tab and try again.

multi.tooFew: At least two of the tabs must be readable. {{reason}}

deep.noneRead: None of the chosen links could be read.

local.noWebGpu: This browser or computer has no WebGPU, which in-browser models need. Choose another AI provider in Settings.
local.noF16: This graphics chip lacks a feature the in-browser models need (16-bit shaders). Choose another AI provider in Settings.
local.notDownloaded: The model is not downloaded yet. Open Settings → AI and click Download.
local.badAnswer: The model gave an answer that could not be read. Try again.

github.network: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
github.rateLimit: GitHub allows 60 reads an hour without a token, and they are used up. Try again after {{time}}, or add a GitHub token in Settings → GitHub.
github.rateLimitToken: Your GitHub token reached its hourly limit. Try again after {{time}}.
github.badToken: GitHub rejected the token. Check it in Settings → GitHub.
github.notFound: GitHub did not find this pull request. If the repository is private, add a GitHub token in Settings → GitHub.
github.noAccessToken: Your GitHub token cannot read this pull request. Give it read access to this repository (Pull requests, Contents).
github.failed: GitHub could not return this pull request (HTTP {{status}}).

gdocs.blocked: Google did not let Siftlume download this file. The owner or your organization may have turned off downloading, or you may only have comment access. Check that you are signed in to the Google account that can open it, or ask for download access.
gdocs.network: Could not reach Google. Check your connection and try again.
gdocs.failed: Google could not export this file (HTTP {{status}}). Reload the tab and try again.
gdocs.emptyDoc: This document has no text to summarize.
gdocs.drivePdfOnly: Siftlume reads PDFs from Google Drive. For other files, open them in Docs, Sheets or Slides, or download them and choose File on the start screen.
gdocs.driveTooBig: This PDF is larger than {{size}} MB. Download it and choose File on the start screen instead.
gdocs.scannedPdf: This PDF has no text layer (it is probably a scan), so there is nothing to read.
